::: {.callout-tip}
### Learning Objectives

By the end of this session, learners will be able to:

- Understand what an LLM is and differences between properietary and open-weight models
- Explain the key stages of an agentic AI workflow (permissions, context engineering, tool-calling, system prompts, skills, etc.)
- Understand pros and cons of various context engineering techniques used in agentic workflows.
:::
